intended_use: Demonstration only. Exercises the analysis pipeline without an ML model.
training_data: None. Deterministic function of image statistics.
validation: Not applicable. Never use for clinical decisions.
limitations: Must be labelled demo in every result.
Exists to test the pipeline offline when no model weights are cached.
input: Any chest image accepted by the ingestion pipeline.
output: A deterministic score and heatmap used only to exercise the UI.
ethical_notes: Demo output must never be shown to a patient or used in care.
